theme_strategy: Hybrid Light & Dark (Dark-first premium Vercel/Linear aesthetic).
instructions_to_main_agent: Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn purple/blue gradients. Follow the STRICT color tokens provided. The aesthetic is monochromatic and ultra-high-end.
Build the Auth UI (Login/Register) EXPLICITLY as a Glassmorphic box floating over an animated blurred background.
Implement 8px grid system. Radius scale from xs (6px) to 2xl (36px).
Use staggered Framer Motion reveals for page loading. No continuous rotation, bounce, or blur animation.
Implement progressive disclosure in the dashboard. Hide non-essential elements until hover/focus.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

Button.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-md font-medium transition-all shadow-sm
Button.secondary: bg-transparent border border-input hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-md transition-all

components.Input: bg-transparent border-border focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring rounded-md transition-all

pages.landing: Hero with dark abstract geometric background, large typography (Cabinet Grotesk), floating glass navbar. Feature bento grid with 1px borders. Marquee for dummy tech logos.
pages.auth: CRITICAL: Full viewport height. Background is an animated subtle mesh gradient. The login/register form is a centered GLASSMORPHIC BOX (`bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10`).
pages.dashboard_shell: Linear-style left sidebar (dark, highly minimal, no heavy backgrounds on hover, just subtle text color changes). Top navbar for breadcrumbs and actions.
pages.dashboard_home: 4 stat cards with subtle sparklines. Quick-start drag-drop card area. Recent items table with minimalist borders.
pages.profile_editor: Rich form. Inputs should have subtle borders. Include a sticky 'AI suggestions' side panel.
pages.resume_builder: Multi-step flow. Live preview pane on the right. AI warnings on the left. High contrast for the actual document preview.
pages.career_tools: Grid of 7 tool cards. Each tool card has a subtle glow or 'tracing beam' effect on hover.
pages.applications_tracker: Kanban board. Minimalist columns. Drag and drop UI. Use `border-dashed` for empty states.
pages.ai_chat: Chat interface. User messages align right (subtle surface background). AI messages align left (transparent background).
pages.admin_panel: Dense data table. High contrast text. Use JetBrains Mono for metrics and IDs.
pages.upload_cv: Large drag-and-drop zone with dashed borders. Subtle pulse animation when hovering with a file.
pages.settings: Vertical tabs layout. High contrast toggles. Danger zone with red bordered buttons.
